description: This source file provides locale-specific culture information for the Sami (Northern) language in Sweden, used by the DateJS library. It includes date and time formats, month and day names, regex patterns for parsing dates, timezone info, and prototype extensions for date manipulation.

methods.name: clearTime
methods.description: Resets hours, minutes, seconds, and milliseconds to zero in a Date object.

methods.name: setTimeToNow
methods.description: Sets the time of the date object to the current time.
